features.name: recency_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket of recency (V1: months since last donation), split into 4 quartile-like bins based on training distribution
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides direct ordinal splits on recency without continuous noise; tree can split on integer thresholds

features.name: frequency_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket of donation frequency (V2: total number of donations), split into 4 bins
features.expected_model_benefit: Discretizes frequency into interpretable bins; tree splits benefit from reduced cardinality

features.name: monetary_per_donation
features.description: Average blood volume donated per donation (V3 / V2), measuring consistency of donation volume
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures per-donation volume ratio; donors with consistent 250cc per donation differ from outliers

features.name: recency_frequency_ratio
features.description: Ratio of recency to frequency (V1 / V2), indicating how long ago relative to how often they donate
features.expected_model_benefit: High ratio means long gap since last donation relative to frequency; nonlinear interaction useful for tree splits

features.name: donation_rate
features.description: Donations per month of tenure (V2 / V4), measuring how actively someone donates over their history
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes frequency by tenure length; active donors have higher rates and may behave differently

features.name: is_recent_donor
features.description: Boolean indicator: 1 if recency (V1) is 3 months or less, indicating very recent donation
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct boolean split on recency threshold; recent donors may have higher likelihood of donating again

features.name: is_frequent_donor
features.description: Boolean indicator: 1 if total donations (V2) exceed 10, indicating high-frequency donor
features.expected_model_benefit: Threshold indicator for high-frequency donors; tree can use this as a direct binary split

features.name: log_monetary
features.description: Log-transformed total blood volume donated (log1p of V3), reducing right skew
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses large monetary values; tree splits on log scale capture nonlinear monetary effects

features.name: tenure_recency_gap
features.description: Difference between tenure (V4) and recency (V1), representing how long before last donation they started
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures how much of their donation history precedes the last donation; long-tenured but recent donors differ from new donors

features.name: high_recency_low_frequency
features.description: Boolean indicator: 1 if recency > 12 months AND frequency <= 3, indicating lapsed infrequent donor
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a specific donor profile combination; tree benefits from pre-computed interaction boolean

features.name: donation_engagement_score
features.description: Holistic engagement score (1-5) based on combined recency, frequency, and tenure signals: 1=very low engagement (high recency, low frequency, short tenure), 5=very high engagement (low recency, high frequency, long tenure)
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple signals into a single ordinal score; tree can split on this composite engagement level

features.name: monetary_deviation_from_standard
features.description: Absolute deviation of average donation volume from 250cc standard (|V3/V2 - 250|), measuring how atypical the per-donation volume is
features.expected_model_benefit: Donors with exactly 250cc per donation are typical; deviations may indicate data anomalies or special cases
